text: Need an improvement and it is expensive. Sorry but I need to save money for meds and I could get the same service from open source apps for free.
author: Stefan Nieto V.
developer_reply: Hi Stefan! There is a 3 day free trial, so you can see if you like it! If you choose to continue, we've aimed to price our app as economically as possible without impacting user's experience with distracting ads. We understand everyone has a different budget and we hope you find what works best for you!
